args.title: Issue 4424: change src/exportUtils.ts
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

In src/exportUtils.ts, the function formatExportFilename uses at.toISOString().slice(0, 10) to insert the date in the filename, which uses UTC date, not the user's local date. This causes exports in the evening to appear with the next day's date in the filename, explaining the issue with Los Angeles evening exports showing tomorrow's date.

args.title: Issue 4429: change src/api/reports.ts
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The duplication endpoint POST /reports/:id/duplicate in src/api/reports.ts truncates the report name to MAX_NAME_LENGTH (120 characters) using truncate(${source.name} (copy), MAX_NAME_LENGTH). When the original name is near the limit, the copied name ends in '...' due to truncation, causing the reported issue where the copy's name ends in '...' instead of '(copy)'.

args.title: Issue 4431: change src/exportUtils.ts
args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

The file src/exportUtils.ts contains the function formatExportFilename which generates export filenames using slugify(reportName). The slugify function in src/util/strings.ts removes all non-ASCII letters, which causes Greek and Cyrillic report names to be lost in export file names. This explains the issue where non-Latin names lose all letters in the output filename.

args.title: Issue 4434: change src/components/UploadForm.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/UploadForm.tsx

The component UploadForm.tsx stores the upload error in state 'problem' and displays it, but the error is not cleared when a new file is picked, only cleared on upload submit. The onChange handler for the file input updates the selected file but does not clear the previous error, which explains the issue of the old error message staying on screen after choosing a new file.
